definition_of_100: No known competition requirement gap, no unresolved source-of-truth conflict, no unverified competition-facing claim, no broken deliverable, and all final-release gates green.

steps.name: SITE_TRUTH_V1
steps.why: All downstream geometry, sightlines, shadow studies and context realism depend on authoritative municipal geometry.
done_when: verified municipal DWG converted through named reproducible toolchain
evidence: ODA File Converter 27.9 verified conversion to R2018 DXF
steps.blocker: Current 3D Jutsu import tool accepts catalog GLBs only; custom municipal GLB must enter through a supported custom-file import boundary before reconciliation.

steps.name: Canonical Blender world
steps.why: Plan, section, axon and hero must derive from one scene.
evidence: Higgsfield project revision 15: blend etag 02fa49ad3fc6c3f16b1437603cbf1837; glb etag 6eedb918dc908bf9b0bdad38f97cf2f7

steps.name: Architecture vs brief closure
steps.why: Program and plaza requirements carry major jury weight and cannot remain approximate.
done_when: all official program items mapped to scene evidence
evidence: config/program_audit_v1.json — kitchens + 8 admin workstations now scene-backed

steps.name: Structural/Gaudi proof
steps.why: Gaudi logic is worth 20 points and must be functional rather than cosmetic.

steps.name: Environmental validation
steps.why: Passive performance is explicit jury value and strengthens architectural credibility.

steps.name: Material/construction reality
steps.why: Final realism now depends more on assemblies, contact and material response than on object count.
done_when: hero-frame materials use final PBR definitions
material choices solve stated performance need

steps.name: Hero frame >=9/10
steps.why: The hero must compress the thesis into an immediate jury read.

steps.name: A1 jury board
steps.why: The board controls whether judges can perceive the other 90 points.

steps.name: Optional A4 design object
steps.why: Threshold Stall 01 can earn separate distinction and prove the long-life/short-life system at human scale.

steps.name: Hostile final release audit
steps.why: Submission failure modes are avoidable and must be eliminated before upload.

rules: No new architectural concept unless authoritative context invalidates the current one.
Every task must either increase an official jury criterion or remove a release risk.
No step may be marked DONE from prose alone; it requires inspectable evidence.
A later revision cannot become canonical without explicit manifest promotion.
